\textbf{Protocol note.} Generated directly from the registry in \texttt{src/horus/eval/ground\_truth.py}, the single structure that drives the structurer's field specification, the scorer and the reference extractor, so this listing cannot drift from the code. The German label is the canonical EN~16931 term, which is not always the wording a real page prints; corpus-measured printed labels are tracked separately (\S\ref{sec:validity-specification}). Types: \emph{money} and \emph{rate} are decimal-normalised, \emph{date} is ISO-normalised, \emph{code} is vocabulary-mapped and \emph{string} is whitespace-normalised, symmetrically on both reference and prediction.
